Shared environment

Bounds: [−2.8, 2.8] m on each axis. Region centers: A = (1.10, 0.25), B = (−1.10, −0.25) m. Circle centers: ±0.8 n, with radius 0.35 m. Labels follow your reference screenshot.

The layout is a proposal for review. The green loops only illustrate possible passage choices; they do not establish feasibility, safety, or a preferred route.

Continuous spatial disturbance

The field is a synthetic additive acceleration d(p), in m/s². It is evaluated directly from the equations below for the map. It is not an airflow/CFD model. Shading shows magnitude, not belief uncertainty or clarity.

t = (B − A) / ‖B − A‖,   n = (−tᵧ, tₓ)
s = p · t,   r = p · n
d₁(p) = 1.8 exp{−½[(s / L)⁴ + (r / 0.35)²]} (t + 0.2 n)
d₂(p) = d₁(p) + 1.8 W(s; −1.3, 1.3, 0.35) W(r; 0.85, 1.95, 0.25) t
L = 0.7050321357924049 m

W(x; a, b, e) = S((x − a) / e) S((b − x) / e), where S(z) = 6z⁵ − 15z⁴ + 10z³ for z clamped to [0, 1]. The same field definition applies at every position, independent of the chosen route.
